prompts.name: Veil Tear
prompts.details: A narrow jagged violet slit in the veil. Fine branching floor fissures gather bone-purple spark clusters; the slit opens upward with irregular torn edges, then folds closed into tiny wisps. Match row A of reference 1; recognizable dark hollow and asymmetric jagged purple/bone rim. NOT a stone gate.
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent pixel-art sprite sheet for a top-down fantasy Godot game.
Input images: reference 1 is the previously approved A/B/C concept directions, reference 2 is a current 32px Rootling WALK sprite sheet for actual pixel density and dark outline only. Do not include the Rootling or any character.
Primary request: Build SIX genuinely changing chronological drawings of the described compact enemy-arrival VFX. One family per sheet. Exact layout 3 columns x 2 rows, SIX equal square cells, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Canvas aspect ratio 3:2 (ideally 1536x1024, each512 square). No gutters, labels, drawn grid, letters, captions or scene. Each cell logical64x64 at8x nearest enlargement; intentionally chunky pixel clusters, 1logicalpx near-black contours and restrained bone highlights, roughly the same detail density as reference2. Entire image true transparent alpha. Effect only, absolutely NO painted ground/soil patch or rectangle/matte behind the effect. Its small crack, local dust and tiny shadow are allowed, not the broad dirt island in reference1.
Motion: cell1 warning little planted fissure; cell2 gathering warning, slightly rising; cell3 narrow emergence starting; cell4 open peak; cell5 collapse; cell6 sparse remnant dying out. This is a one-shot, not a looping pulse. Track recognizable chips/ribbons through the consecutive cells, deliberate anticipation-open-close arc.
Registration: every cell shares identical camera, pixel density and world floor pivot at logical(x32,y52), corresponding(x256,y416) in each512cell. It is a VFX changing shape naturally but NEVER translate or tilt the complete effect or resize individual drawings. Bottom floor crack in cells1–5 remains at that identical pivot. Effect max width44logicalpx, height42logicalpx, at least8logicalpx transparent side margins, minimum4px top/bottom padding. No cell spills over another. Compact so normal 27px King/24px enemy remain readable; base approximately28logicalpx. View at same 3/4 top-down camera as reference1.
Palette: near-black141522, shadow2a2034, muted violet604077/9569ae, restrained ivorye3bd88, earth634d39 where appropriate. Upper-left light. High readable contrast on both grass and ash.
Avoid: vector art, smooth blurry edges, neon bloom, antialiasing, text, symbols, circle rings, monsters, furniture, vegetation, opaque ground plane, independent frame zooms, swaying whole root origin.
Family: Veil Tear. A narrow jagged violet slit in the veil. Fine branching floor fissures gather bone-purple spark clusters; the slit opens upward with irregular torn edges, then folds closed into tiny wisps. Match row A of reference 1; recognizable dark hollow and asymmetric jagged purple/bone rim. NOT a stone gate.

prompts.name: Earthwake
prompts.details: A small physical eruption of rough brown/charcoal rock chips and sandy dust, with a little violet fissure below. Loose textured fragments rise and fall outward as a dark hollow opens and closes. Match row B of reference 1. Stone edges remain rough and strongly outlined, chunks visibly follow an arc rather than random changing positions.

prompts.name: Shadow Cocoon
prompts.details: An inky purple smoke shroud gathers into folded ribbons that part from the middle and collapse. Match row C of reference 1; low pooled shadow becomes a narrow pointed cocoon with two twisting purple ribbons then dissolves into short wisps. Mysterious, tactile pixel smoke, not smooth vectors.
